headline: SAFF holds 4.32 on Female Daily (now 1,747 reviews, Las Pozas +1), while non-official decant shops and Watsons travel sizes widen how shoppers try SAFF at Rp20k–89k.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily flat vs yesterday and vs 10 Nov: Alchemist 4.43, SAFF 4.32 (1,747 reviews; Las Pozas 91→92, still 4.6). HMNS, Mykonos and Onix pages not readable today.
Share gap: Compas Q2 2026 Shopee data ranks SAFF 4th at 3.52%, vs Mykonos 6.75% and HMNS 5.06%.
Retail scores run far above Female Daily: S.O.T.B has 4.9 from 1,423 Zalora reviews but 4.1 from 586 on Female Daily.
Unofficial channels keep growing: a non-official Tokopedia shop sells SAFF decants from about Rp20.5k (2 ml) labelled '100% original', with no authorised-seller proof.
Packaging portability is a repeat theme: Eulalie's newest review (5.0) praises wear but says the bottle is not travel-friendly, echoing earlier big-bottle complaints.

recommendations.text: Report unverified SAFF resellers and decant shops on Tokopedia, and publish an authorised-reseller list plus a 'how to spot a fake' guide.
Push the official 8 ml travel size (Watsons Morfosia Rp89k) as the safe trial option, and answer the 'bottle not travel-friendly' complaint in product copy.
Counter Mykonos Soft Hour with ads that use high retail scores (S.O.T.B 4.9 on Zalora), and ask happy buyers to review on Female Daily too.
Find out why S.O.T.B scores 4.1 on Female Daily vs 4.9 on Zalora: read its low-star reviews and fix the top complaint in copy or product.
Run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder so low-star themes can be tracked.
